run_pointnav_example: run the habitat point navigation example that steps an agent through a random episode
create_habitat_env: create a habitat navigation environment using habitat.Env with a pointnav config file
load_habitat_config: load a habitat simulation config using habitat.get_config with a yaml path
reset_episode: reset the habitat environment to start a new navigation episode and get initial observations
step_random_action: step the habitat agent forward by sampling a random action from the action space
